subject: Promo stacking & pilot packaging for SeedBridge cohort
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@seedbridge.vc>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood pilot + sponsor stacking question

Hi Camila —

Thanks again for the demo last week. SeedBridge runs three cohorts/year and we’re planning our May track. A couple quick questions as we scope Redwood into the sponsor benefits bundle: 

1) Sponsor partners want to offer their own compute credits (third-party credits) on top of any Redwood promotional credits — are those allowed to be stacked? If yes, any guardrails?

2) For organizers we typically ask for a 90-day pilot window for teams to ramp — we’d like to request a 90-day free tier for 10 startups in the cohort (rough estimate 150k tokens total). Can Redwood make a promo exception to extend the pilot window and cap?

If helpful I can send the cohort MOU and expected startup list. We’re aiming to finalize sponsor packs by Apr 20. Appreciate any flexibility.

Best,
Elena Park
Program Director | SeedBridge Ventures

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@seedbridge.vc>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot + sponsor stacking question

Hi Elena —

Great to hear from you — glad the demo was useful. Short answers up front: yes, stacking third-party sponsor credits is permissible, but we do need visibility into how those credits are provisioned and a cap on combined usage per startup to protect our shared SLOs. And we can consider a 90-day pilot exception for cohort programs, but it’s an exception so I’ll need to scope the ask with our partner credits policy and get quick approval from my manager / finance.

Would you be able to: 
- Share the draft MOU (just needs the sponsor credit language and orchestration flow)
- Confirm an estimate per-team expected token usage (you said ~150k tokens total; a per-team average helps)

If those look reasonable I’ll propose a tailored packaging: a 90-day pilot with a combined per-team cap (Redwood promo + sponsor credits) and a one-time onboarding fee waiver for the cohort. I’ll loop in Ben for the pricing exception. If you can send the MOU I’ll return a proposed term sheet by EOB Fri (Apr 9).

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: (requested) — seedbridge_draft_mou_placeholder

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood pilot + sponsor stacking question

Ben / Marissa —

Looping you in. SeedBridge is asking to stack sponsor-provided credits with our promotional credits and to make an exception for a 90-day pilot for ~10 startups (~150k tokens total). The ask summary: 

- Program: SeedBridge May cohort (10 startups).
- Request: Allow sponsor credit stacking + extend Redwood cohort pilot from standard 30 days to 90 days.
- Limits: propose combined per-team cap of 25k tokens (aggregate across sponsors + Redwood).
- Commercial sweeteners: waive onboarding fee and provide a discounted rate for overages during the 90 days.

I’ve attached the draft MOU they offered (SeedBridge_MOU_v1.pdf).

Can we do an exception? If so, what guardrails do we need (accounting, reporting, churn protection)? Also we might need an approval for a 40% promo-credit uplift vs the baseline trial.

Thanks —
Camila

--- Forwarded attachment: SeedBridge_MOU_v1.pdf (80KB) ---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood pilot + sponsor stacking question

Camila —

Thanks for the context. High-level thoughts:
- Sponsor stacking: OK if sponsor credits are time-limited, non-transferable, and we receive a list of recipients to map to Redwood accounts (helps prevent double-dipping and fraud).
- 90-day pilot: feasible as a one-off for brand/partner programs but we should protect unit economics. Recommend: 25k token cap per team (as you suggested), plus a hard overage rate of 0.02 USD per 1k tokens for the pilot (discounted from our standard).
- Accounting / billing: require signed MOU and HubSpot deal stage updated to "Pilot - Partner Pack" and finance sign-off. I’ve drafted a pricing-exception sheet — attaching pricing-exception-RDF-2027-759.xlsx.

If Marissa and finance are ok with the 40% uplift on promo credits and the reporting requirements, I’m good to approve. Also suggest we require a short post-pilot review (30 days after pilot end) to evaluate conversion and any quality regressions.

Ben
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing-exception-RDF-2027-759.xlsx

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@seedbridge.vc>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Apr 2027 20:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot + sponsor stacking question — proposed terms

Hi Elena —

Thanks for sending the MOU and the token estimate. We can support your May cohort under the following pilot terms (one-off exception):

- Scope: 10 startups in cohort; sponsor credits allowed to be stacked with Redwood promo credits.
- Duration: 90 days per team starting on each team’s onboarding date.
- Caps: Combined cap of 25,000 tokens per team (Redwood promo + sponsor credits).
- Overages: $0.02 per 1k tokens during pilot if a team exceeds the cap.
- Onboarding: onboarding fee waived for the cohort.
- Reporting: SeedBridge must provide a roster CSV and mapping of sponsor credits to Redwood account IDs before activation; Redwood will provide a weekly usage dashboard link for the cohort.
- Review: 30-day post-pilot conversion review to decide follow-on packaging and pricing.

Next steps: please sign the attached MOU and return via DocuSign (I’ve prepared a link). Once we receive the roster and sponsor-credit mapping we’ll provision the promo credits and enable the pilot.

Link to DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/RDF-2027-759
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7345621

If this looks good I’ll draft the activation checklist and work with your ops person to schedule onboards the week of May 2.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
